name: BhasaAnuvaad: Large-Scale Speech Translation Dataset for 14 South Asian Languages
description: BhasaAnuvaad is a large-scale speech-to-text translation benchmark created by AI4Bharat at IIT Madras covering 14 major South Asian languages. Spanning high-quality spontaneous and read speech paired with expert human translations, it encompasses 314,670 audio clips supporting bidirectional translation between South Asian languages (including Bangla, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, and Urdu) and English.
